title: The Ant Lion
text: The sand gives way without a sound, sliding into a funnel as wide as a field. Bones ring the slope, picked clean and polished. At the bottom, a pair of mandibles opens and waits.

outcomes.text: You haul yourselves over the rim, gasping, with sand in everything. Far below, the mandibles click shut.
It collapses the sand beneath you as you scramble up the slope, and you plunge down toward its open maw.

options.label: The strongest tries to haul everyone out as they scramble for the rim.

outcomes.text: Arms shaking, the strongest pulls them out one at a time. Below, the mandibles snap shut on nothing.

options.label: It's too treacherous to attempt escape. Draw your weapons and dispatch the beast.

outcomes.text: It fights from the bottom of its pit. When at last it dies, one mandible comes away whole, long and hooked, still wet with venom.
